name: io.github.iowarp/pandas-mcp
title: CLIO Pandas
description: Pandas MCP - Advanced Data Analysis for LLMs with comprehensive pandas operations

tools.name: load_data
tools.description: Load and parse data from CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet, or HDF5 files with optional column selection and row limiting.

tools.name: save_data
tools.description: Save data to CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet, or HDF5 with auto-detected format and optional index inclusion.

tools.name: statistical_summary
tools.description: Compute descriptive statistics, distribution analysis, and outlier detection for numerical and categorical columns.

tools.name: correlation_analysis
tools.description: Compute correlation matrices (Pearson, Spearman, or Kendall) with significance testing and strong-correlation detection.

tools.name: hypothesis_testing
tools.description: Run statistical hypothesis tests (t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, normality, Mann-Whitney) with p-values and effect sizes.

tools.name: handle_missing_data
tools.description: Detect, impute, or remove missing values using strategies like mean/median/mode fill, forward/backward fill, or interpolation.

tools.name: clean_data
tools.description: Remove duplicates, detect outliers via IQR/Z-score, and optimize data types in a single pass.

tools.name: groupby_operations
tools.description: Group data by columns and apply aggregations (sum, mean, count, min, max, std, median) with optional pre-filter.

tools.name: merge_datasets
tools.description: Join two datasets using inner, outer, left, or right joins on specified key columns.

tools.name: pivot_table
tools.description: Create pivot tables with configurable row index, column headers, value columns, and aggregation function.

tools.name: time_series_operations
tools.description: Resample, compute rolling statistics, create lag features, or difference a time series.

tools.name: validate_data
tools.description: Validate columns against rules for min/max range, data type, nullability, uniqueness, and regex patterns.

tools.name: filter_data
tools.description: Filter rows using comparison, membership, pattern-matching, and null-check operators across multiple columns.

tools.name: optimize_memory
tools.description: Analyze and reduce DataFrame memory usage through automatic dtype optimization and chunked-processing recommendations.

tools.name: profile_data
tools.description: Generate a full dataset profile: shape, types, missing values, distributions, quality checks, and optional correlations.

resources.name: pandas_capabilities
resources.description: Supported pandas operations and file formats.

prompts.name: analyze_dataset
prompts.description: Guided workflow for exploring and analyzing a dataset.
